zh_summary: @ylecun estimates filling 600 liter tanks at 600 bar would take ~220 MJ in theory and ~400 MJ (~110 kWh) with compressor losses, more than a full Tesla Model S battery, questioning the Roadster thruster system. $TSLA
en_summary: @ylecun estimates filling 600 liter tanks at 600 bar would take ~220 MJ in theory and ~400 MJ (~110 kWh) with compressor losses, more than a full Tesla Model S battery, questioning the Roadster thruster system. $TSLA
text:
To fill 600 liter tanks at 600 bars (8700 PSI) takes, in theory, 220 MJoules. 

Taking into account the efficiency of the complex compressor requires for this, the total energy consumed would probably be around 400MJ, or about 110 kWh (more energy than a full Tesla S battery).

This would take at least 12 hours with current compressor technology (which requires dessication, cooling, etc).

All of this for a few seconds of jet boost.
